Although it is called a "chō" (庁), it is not a government office, but rather an umbrella religious corporation under the jurisdiction of the {{ill|Minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology|fa|وزیر آموزش، فرهنگ، ورزش، علوم و فناوری|fr|Ministre japonais de l'Éducation, de la Culture, des Sports, des Sciences et de la Technologie|ja|文部科学大臣|ko|일본의 문부과학대신|nl|Lijst van Japanse ministers van Onderwijs|simple|Minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology|vi|Bộ trưởng Giáo dục, Văn hóa, Thể thao, Khoa học và Công nghệ|zh|文部科學大臣|qid=Q842359|lt=Minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology}} based on the {{ill|Religious Corporation Act|de|Gesetz über die Religionsgesellschaften|ja|宗教法人法|zh|宗教法人法|qid=Q11451965}}.<ref>[https://www.bunka.go.jp/tokei_hakusho_shuppan/hakusho_nenjihokokusho/shukyo_nenkan/pdf/h30nenkan.pdf]{{ill|Religious Yearbook, Heisei 30 Edition|ja|宗教年鑑 平成30th year 版}} {{ill|Agency for Cultural Affairs|ar|وكالة الشؤون الثقافية اليابانية|ast|Axencia p'Asuntos Culturales|ca|Agència d'Afers Culturals|cy|Asiantaeth Materion Diwylliannol Siapan|de|Bunka-chō|es|Agencia para Asuntos Culturales|fa|دفتر امور فرهنگی|fr|Agence pour les Affaires culturelles|id|Badan Urusan Budaya|ja|文化庁|ko|일본 문화청|pt|Agência para Assuntos Culturais|ru|Агентство по делам культуры|tr|Kültür İşleri Ajansı|uk|Управління культури Японії|zh|文化廳|qid=Q1009519|lt=Agency for Cultural Affairs}} (ed.) p.103</ref>

Association of Shinto Shrines is responsible for handling various administrative matters—including personnel and finances of prefectural {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=shrines}}—guiding shrines and [[:en:Kannushi|Shinto priests]], and promoting ritual and community activities. It also serves as the public relations office for shrine activities. In most cases, the office of the Association of Shinto Shrines is located within or adjacent to a relatively large shrine in that prefecture.

As a subordinate organization of the Association of Shinto Shrines, regional branches are established. These branches divide each prefecture into several districts, with one branch set up per district.

Many Association of Shinto Shrines have been incorporated as {{ill|Religious corporation|ja|宗教法人|lt=Religious corporations}}, in which case they become subordinate corporations of the Association of Shinto Shrines. Even then, the shrines within that prefecture are not managed by the local Association of Shinto Shrines office but are directly administered by the subordinate corporation of the Association of Shinto Shrines.
